name: folder
description: A rounded folder silhouette with a distinct tab and a straight movable front-panel edge.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Original rounded rectangular outer contour preserves the folder tab and is drawn once. The front-panel upper edge is a single straight horizontal stroke at y=10, meeting the side walls without retracing the sides or bottom. Lower corners use matching 2.5-unit construction for balanced spacing. The existing named body/lid parts, stroke defaults and motion recipe are retained; only geometry is revised for static review.
